task.title: Adding a new tag to an image tag to an image by using the API
task.shortdesc: To add a new tag or restore an older tag on an image in Red Hat Quay, you can use the API.

ul.li: You have Created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: You can change which image a tag points to or create a new tag by using the PUT /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/{tag} command:
You can restore a repository tag to its previous image by using the POST /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/{tag}/restore command. For example:
To see a list of tags after creating a new tag you can use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/ command. For example:
